Name: Houston Skin (Dermatology Associates of Texas)
About: Dermatology Associates of Texas (Houston Skin), is a leading medical and cosmetic dermatology practice in the greater Houston area, serving the communities of Webster, the Houston Museum District, and Pearland, Texas. The highly trained team of dermatologists welcomes patients in to receive the most current medical and cosmetic skin treatments and products available and to improve or maintain their overall skin health.Patients regularly visit Dermatology Associates of Texas with new or worsening skin irritation or other symptoms. The team provides in-depth evaluations and can accurately diagnose common and uncommon conditions like acne, rosacea, cold sores, eczema, shingles, and psoriasis. They also test moles and other growths for skin cancer and can provide Mohs surgery as treatment. Every patient receives an individualized care plan for their condition at Dermatology Associates of Texas. In addition to prescription medications and helpful home care tips, the team at Dermatology Associates of Texas provides many in-office treatments and therapies to target skin conditions or hair loss. A few featured options are platelet-rich plasma (PRP) for hair loss, laser treatments, chemical peels, and corticosteroid injections. In addition to clinical services, Dermatology Associates of Texas offers a broad selection of elective cosmetic treatments. Patients frequently visit for cosmetic injectables like Botox® and fillers, body contouring, earlobe repair, microdermabrasion, facials, and microneedling.

Name: Dermatology Associates of Concord
About:
The physicans at Dermatology Associates are experts in diseases of the skin, hair and nails. Since we are trained in the treatment of disorders of all age groups, we are able to care for infants, children, adults and the elderly. We care for all of the common, as well as the chronic, and most of the complicated skin disorders.

Name: Northstar Dermatology
About:
WHAT WE DO

We know skin matters – not just for all of its physiologic qualities, but for the identity and confidence it imbues us. After all, our skin is how the world sees us. As the leading Dermatology practice in North Texas, we are your home for all things skin. We heal people, we restore confidence, and we empower our patients with knowledge of prevention. We practice up-to-date medicine that is grounded in evidence, in an environment free of industry or social influence. You won’t walk into a lobby filled with cosmetic marketing posters or be swayed to buy products you don’t need. We prescribe treatments tailored to you with cost, time, and your lifestyle in mind.

OUR TEAM

Simply put - everyone on our team is a rockstar. We are honored and proud to have doctors that come from the top programs in the country such as Harvard Medical School and UT Southwestern. All of our providers are incredibly smart, but more importantly, they are genuinely great people to work with. We also proudly recognize that our staff is the reason for our growth and success! Our medical assistants, patient coordinators, and billing department are made up of hard working, resilient, innovative people who strive to make our practice better each day. We’re always challenging ourselves and challenging each other to offer the best care and to create an unexpectedly positive experience for our patients.

OUR VALUES
Our core values are the foundation of everything we do at Northstar Dermatology. Every member of our team not only believes in our core values, but lives them.
1. Be EVEN Better: Make large strides through small steps. The key to success is consistent action. 
2. Act Intentionally: Every action should be performed deliberately and with intention. 
3. 100% Authentic: We work to promote open, honest conversation in a professional tone and judgment free environment.
4. Right & Good: Do the right thing and make good on your word. Own your intentions, your words, and your deeds.

Name: Infinite Beauty Lounge Boston
About:
As the founder of Infinite Beauty Lounge, LLC, Lara understands that as people age, they are looking for nonsurgical ways to look their best.  Prior to founding Infinite Beauty Lounge, Lara was co-owner of Boston Electrology and Skin Therapies, a state of the art Medspa. Besides being co-owner, Lara administered all the injectables and received advanced training in the treatment of cheek, jawline, and lip augmentation, as well as the use of Sculptra, the collagen stimulator.  She has been administering injectables for the past decade.

Lara graduated with a BSN from McGill University in 1991 and received her Masters in Public Health (MPH) and CNM from Boston University in 1998.  Lara transitioned into the field of medical esthetics and received training from the Esthetic Skin Institute.  She is also a proud member of American Academy of Medical Esthetic Professionals (AAMEP) and International Society of Plastic and Esthetic Nurses (ISPAN). 



More recently, Lara became a certified BioTe provider, offering bio-identical hormones in pellet form, which are implanted into the hip area of both men and women to help optimize their hormone levels and help with many common symptoms of aging. The treatment is customized based on a patient’s symptoms and lab values. 

Lara continues to work per diem as a certified nurse-midwife at Harvard-affiliated Brigham and Women's Hospital.  

Infinite Beauty Lounge's mission is to provide personalized, medical esthetic services in a safe comfortable environment.  We believe educating our clients on the services which best suit their needs, is essential to helping them to look and feel their best.

Name: Lakeview Dermatology
About:
Conveniently located in Chicago's Lakeview neighborhood and the northern and southwest suburbs, Lakeview Dermatology Chicago offers state-of-the art patient care in general, cosmetic dermatology treatments and surgical dermatology. Our patient-centered approach to care was started by Dr. Eugene Mandrea over 40 years ago and continues today.

Sir William Osler, the father of modern medicine, once said, "Listen to the patient. He is telling you the diagnosis." These words are still true today.
 
At Lakeview Dermatology, we know that listening means more than taking your medical history. Your viewpoint is an integral part of your treatment decision. We learn the context of your skin condition in order to consider its physical, physiological, and emotional impact on your life. When we make a diagnosis, we'll suggest your options for treatment in understandable terms. Whether medical, surgical, or cosmetic, we'll explain the concept of our therapeutic approach and why we're recommending it.
 
We also follow strict safety and sterilization guidelines and we comply with all HIPAA rules regarding patient confidentiality.
 
At Lakeview Dermatology, we're here to help you achieve better skin for a happier, healthier life.

Name: SJH Derm
About: SJH Derm is a collective group of physician-owned dermatology practices located in Illinois, focusing on medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology. The organization includes several practices, such as Dermatology Associates of La Grange, Dermatology Associates of Lombard, GoldinSkin Dermatology, and North Suburban Dermatology Associates.
Description:
We are a physician-driven & employee-owned group of community-based dermatology practices around the Chicagoland area. As the healthcare industry continues to evolve in a changing world, it is our mission to preserve the fundamentals of exceptional dermatological care through meaningful doctor-patient relationships; because we love our patients, and we love what we do.
 
SJH Derm was founded in 2019 by Dr. Shelley J. Halper, a board-certified dermatologist who has served the La Grange community since she opened her practice Dermatology Associates of La Grange, in 1991. 

Dr. Halper’s desire to collaborate and grow, while also continuing to provide the highest quality of care, posed quite a challenge. She watched as many of her friends and fellow colleagues sold their practices to private equity-backed groups and knew that she wanted something different for her private practice; something that would allow for an uninterrupted continuity of care for her patients, as well as job security for her esteemed colleagues and staff members.
 
As an employee-owned organization, we share the benefits of our hard work and dedication to our patients and our communities. We hope to inspire change for the betterment of the future of healthcare in order to get back to the real bottom line of what matters, patient health and care.

Physician Grade vitamins and supplements add value to more advanced treatments of weight management and body shaping.

In addition to being known as the Philly Diet Doctor, Dr. Jon Fisher and members of his Aesthetic Medicine team are fully trained and certified in multiple cosmetic procedures. He and his team operate out of 4 locations in the Delaware Valley Region serving patients in Philadelphia, Lower Merion in Montgomery County, Delaware County, Bucks County and South Jersey.

Name: Laserderm
About:
At Laserderm, world renowned dermatologist and laser skin specialist Dr. Sharyn Laughlin masterfully blends clinical dermatology with the art and science of cutaneous lasers for optimal patient care. Dr. Laughlin is a pioneer in the field of laser dermatology, and has been involved in laser research and laser skin surgery since the 1980’s. 

 Dr. Laughlin and her highly qualified staff at Laserderm will give you what your skin deserves… the best care possible.

Dr. Laughlin is one of a select group of three Canadian dermatologists who started the sub-specialty of laser dermatology in 1983. A Canadian pioneer in dermatologic laser surgery, she received her early training from Dr. Leon Goldman, the renowned “father” of laser surgery.

For over 25 years Laserderm has provided unique expertise in laser skin surgery to over 100,000 patients from across Canada, the USA, and  as far away as Greece, Malaysia and Brazil. Expertise comes best from formal specialty training and long experience. Laserderm medical director Sharyn Laughlin has been a board certified dermatologist (Canada, U.S.A.) since 1981. A specialist in laser skin surgery since 1983, Dr. Laughlin has been immersed in every aspect of laser medicine‑ research, teaching, and patient care.

Laserderm was established in 1987 as a national and international treatment centre to treat portwine stain birthmarks. In 1991, the Ontario Ministry of Health selected Laserderm to be a licensed Independent Health Facility for the laser treatment of vascular lesions. It is still the only such facility in Ontario and is a leading research and teaching centre for the development of new technology. Laserderm’s academic links include a major contribution to training physicians who now perform laser skin surgery. Over 800 physicians worldwide have received training in cutaneous laser surgery from Dr. Sharyn Laughlin.

Profile: Dr. Sarah Mess, Board Certified Plastic Surgeon
Name: Dr. Sarah Mess, Board Certified Plastic Surgeon
About:
Dr. Mess is the daughter of an orthopedic surgeon father and artist mother, who naturally inspired her approach to plastic surgery. Combining artistry with surgery, Dr. Mess has developed a unique practice tailored to the goals and concerns of her patients. Whether it’s more shapely breast, a slimmer waist, or a more youthful face, Dr. Mess’ surgical skills provide patients with exceptional, natural looking results. While many cosmetic and reconstructive patients seek out Dr. Mess solely for her surgical expertise, others come to Dr. Mess to avoid surgery.

Dr. Mess believes that while surgery is often the best answer, it is by no means the only answer. We live in an amazing age of aesthetic medical advances. Twenty years ago there was no Botox, no dermal filler, no CoolSculpting. Today non-invasive products and technologies are some of the fastest growing aesthetic procedures worldwide. Dr. Mess is constantly exploring the latest and best products and technologies to incorporate into her practice. She combines surgical expertise with the newest advances in non-invasive fat reduction, skin tightening technologies, lasers and fat transfer to offer the very best aesthetic results for both her surgical and non-surgical patients.

Born in Washington, D.C. and raised in Olney, Maryland, Dr. Mess has strong ties to the region. She is affiliated with the Howard County General Hospital in Columbia, Northwest Hospital in Randallstown, Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, and Montgomery General Hospital in Olney. She is a part-time instructor at Johns Hopkins and was named Plastic Surgery Section Chief at Howard County General in 2014.

Name: Miller Vein
About:
We are Michigan’s top vein treatment practice, committed to the health and happiness of our patients. Over 2,000 doctors have referred their patients to Miller Vein. Our physicians have been honored as Detroit Top Docs by Hour Detroit Magazine. 

We’ve won Detroit Free Press Best of the Best awards for Best Vein Clinic, Best Medical Specialty Clinic, and Best Medical Spa. The Detroit Free Press named us to their Top Workplaces lists in 2020, 2021, and 2022. Crain’s Detroit Business has listed us among the Best Places to Work in Michigan six times, including in 2023.

The Miller Vein team provides fast, safe, and effective treatments. We educate patients about vein conditions and create individualized treatment plans that best serve their needs. Varicose vein treatments are covered by most insurance plans. 

VeinErase®, our exclusive spider vein treatment includes a unique combination of therapeutic techniques to treat spider veins. We only use FDA-approved medications, and we screen all spider vein patients for more serious medical conditions. 

Over 25 million people in the U.S. are affected with vein disorders. Miller Vein is committed to using state-of-the-art technologies that identify and care for patients before vein disorders become a more serious issue. If not treated, venous reflux disease can lead to advanced medical conditions like venous leg ulcers or deep vein thrombosis. 

Jeffrey H. Miller, M.D., is the founder and CEO of Miller Vein. He has received numerous awards and honors in his field, including being named one of Hour Detroit Magazine’s Top Docs. Dr. Miller is a frequent contributor for Vein Therapy News while serving on the Editorial Advisory Board.

Name: Uptown Eye Specialists
About:
At Uptown Eye Specialists, our dedicated group of ophthalmologists are committed to providing patient-centered subspecialty eye care in an advanced and innovative medical and surgical facility.  We aim to care for our patients compassionately in a technologically cutting edge environment using the latest advances in clinical research.  Our philosophy is to provide our patients a choice in their eye care – the opportunity to choose from premier products and technologies that are at the forefront of ophthalmology.  We also aim to work with our referral network to provide seamless and safe eye care for our mutual patients.

In addition to our traditional eye care clinic – Uptown Eye Specialists is home to several subspecialized programs and providers that allow us to treat the full spectrum of ocular disorders.  These include: Cataract, Comprehensive Ophthalmology, Medical and Surgical Retina, Glaucoma, Pediatric and Strabismus, Cornea and Anterior Segment, Oculoplastics, Refractive Laser Vision Correction, Orthoptics, Low Vision, and a dedicated full service Dry Eye Clinic.

Our on-site surgical centre, called “U Surgical Centre” provides our patients a convenient location to have their surgical procedures.  Our out-of-hospital premise has been awarded the highest level of certification (OHP 3) – and provides our patients the comfort and safety required to achieve successful outcomes.  Example of procedures that are performed at the U Surgical Centre include:
Refractive Laser Vision Correction
Cataract Surgery
Corneal Crosslinking
Pterygium Surgery
Anterior Segment Surgery
Eyelid and Blepharoplasty Surgery
All types of Cosmetic Surgery

Our model is direct, proactive, and highly personalized; allowing our providers the time and flexibility to listen, test deeply, and act strategically. We partner with patients who want to take ownership of their health, reduce future disease risk, and invest in long-term performance and vitality.

Yoo Direct Health exists for those who believe healthcare should be preventative, precise, and focused on helping people live longer, better lives.
